messages:
emily: Alert: KMS key rotation failed for customer-managed keys in private deployments (apac-1 + eu-3). Affected decrypt calls returning 403. Customer impact: unable to load encrypted model weights, ~4% of private inference requests failing.
zane: I'm seeing KMS errors in the deployment logs: "AccessDenied: key not available for region" starting at 09:12 UTC. Likely a cross-region replication misconfig during rotation.
quentin: Paging sec-ops and infra oncall. @oncall-bot create incident.
oncall-bot: PagerDuty incident PD-5709 created and assigned to infra-oncall. https://pagerduty.com/incidents/PD-5709
sec-ops: Confirmed: rotation job kicked off but replication flag didn't set for secondary regions due to a recent IAM role change. Reverting role change now.
emily: Short-term mitigation: switching affected customers to fallback host-side ephemeral key (local unencrypted path) where policy allows; CS notified for customers without fallback. Applying allowlist per-deployment.
quentin: Command applied to apac-1/eu-3: `redwoodctl kms fallback-enable --deployment private-prod --regions apac-1,eu-3`
status-bot: Status page updated: https://status.redwoodinference.com/incidents/PD-5709 - "Customer-managed KMS rotation failed for some private deployments; mitigations in progress."
zane: Reverted IAM change and re-ran rotation with replication flag. Monitoring rekey logs; decrypt errors decreasing.
sec-ops: Confirming rekey completed for eu-3; apac-1 still retrying due to transient API rate limit. Backoff in place.
cs-lead: CS team notified affected enterprise accounts and offered workaround details. Incident communication draft posted in #customer-success.
emily: Metrics: decrypt 403s down from 4% to 0.6%. Keeping fallback enabled for 30m while we validate keys and run full integration tests.
quentin: Follow-up action items: 1) Add IAM change guardrail to prevent rotations with missing replication flag 2) Add pre-rotation dry-run validation that checks regional key availability 3) Document fallback enablement steps in runbook INF-RUNBOOK-09
sec-ops: Filing tickets: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/SEC-6010 , https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/INF-8105, https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/OPS-2211
oncall-bot: Incident PD-5709 status changed: mitigated -> monitoring
emily: Thanks team. I'll publish postmortem and customer timeline in ~2h once keys fully validated.
